text:
Maya: Quick sync to capture action items from the KV-cache OOM postmortem (3/18 deploy). Need owners, short deadlines, and check-ins.

Aj: I'll run the targeted profiler and collect heap snapshots on staging. Plan is to replay the incident traffic and capture a 20-30m trace.

Sara: I'll own GC tuning and short-term soft limits. Proposal: introduce `kv.soft_limit_pct=70` and `kv.hard_eviction_threshold=95` for a 72h trial.

Leo: I'll do canary rollout orchestration and dashboards. Need metric names and artifact locations from Aj and Priya.

Priya: I'll add a weekly anomaly job that looks for bursty growth patterns and auto-tags shards with >3 spikes in 7d. Also will backfill 60d.

Aj: Repro steps (staging):
```
# reserve staging pool
./infra/reserve_pool --pool staging-kv --duration 3h --start 1765443600
# replay
./tools/replay --from 2026-03-18T02:00Z --dur 2h --rate 1x --isolate
# tracer
./bin/kv-profiler --out /tmp/kv-profile.pb --time 25m
```

Aj: Upload plan: profile bundles ~150-250MB -> gs://redwood-dev/kv-profiles/1765439999/ with README.txt explaining the run config.

OpsBot: pool reserved staging-kv from 1765443600 to 17654446800. Owner: infra-team. :white_check_mark:

Maya: Owners & due dates: Aj (profiling) - +2 business days (1765610000), Sara (GC & soft limits) - +4 bd, Leo (canary) - +5 bd, Priya (anomaly) - +7 bd. Okay?

Aj: +2bd is tight but doable if infra helps. @OpsBot please confirm the reserve.

Sara: I'll open a small PR with knobs and eviction logging. Will also add a frag_ratio histogram for debugging.

Leo: Canary plan: ramp 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 12h windows, gate on avg_gc_pause < 200ms and no OOMs. Dashboards: per-shard resident_bytes, evicted_count, frag_ratio, avg_gc_pause_ms.

Priya: Metric names: `kv.resident_bytes`, `kv.evicted`, `kv.frag_ratio`, `kv.gc_pause_ms` — I'll use these for the anomaly job. Backfill will ingest 60-90d.

Maya: Risk notes: profiling could raise latency, so keep the run isolated from production traffic. Frag ratio is noisy -> use 5m median smoothing in panels.

Aj: I'll run with `--isolate=true` and mark traces so dashboards ignore replay tags.

Sara: PR draft: https://git.internal/redwood/kv-service/pulls/4927 (soft limits + eviction logs + compaction TODO).

Leo: Dashboard skeleton: https://grafana.redwood/d/kv/oom-hunting (will add panels once Aj uploads traces).

Priya: I'll create the anomaly alert: condition = rate(kv.resident_bytes[1h]) > baseline + 3*sigma OR frag_ratio spikes. If triggered 3x in 7d -> create PD ticket.

Maya: Action matrix in-thread: Aj: profiling run & upload; Sara: softlimit PR & tests; Leo: canary plan + dashboards; Priya: anomaly job + backfill.

Maya: Weekly status check Fridays 10am PT until stable. Please post one-line status here by EOD tomorrow.

Aj: status: replay scheduled, profiler flags ready, will upload artifacts after run.

Sara: status: PR open, basic unit tests passing, running integration in staging.

Leo: status: dashboard panels templated, need metric tags from Aj.

Priya: status: anomaly job config ready, starting backfill tonight.

Maya: Thanks everyone. Ping me if blockers. :thumbsup:

Leo: note - if frag_ratio remains >0.45 after GC tuning, consider triggering a manual compaction run as follow-up.

Sara: adding compaction playbook to PR description.

Priya: Also recommend expanding CI test harness to include a small memory-growth smoke test to catch regressions earlier.

Aj: filing CI expansion ticket now.

Maya: Closing thread for now. Will post Friday summary here.

Aj: end.
